$meta.name: doinstruct Ask frontline design tokens
$meta.description: Framework-agnostic source of truth. tokens.css is generated from this file and consumed by Tailwind v4 via @theme. Agents: read this file to understand INTENT; read tokens.css to know the utility class names.
$meta.derivedFrom: doinstruct's own Webflow swatch system, read from their production stylesheet. Exact values, not eyeballed. Divergences are marked with `divergence` and a reason. Do not 'correct' them back to brand values.
$meta.contrastPolicy: Every text pair clears 7:1 and every border clears 3:1, enforced by scripts/check-contrast.mjs on every `npm run check`. Two brand swatches did not meet that floor and were darkened; both are recorded below.
$meta.environment: Shared, wall-mounted or cart-mounted device on a food-production floor. Wet hands, cut-resistant gloves, 85-95 dB ambient, variable lighting from washdown-bright to dim cold-store. No login.

ink.usage: Text on light surfaces; fill for the primary action's label.

yellow.note: Their system calls this yellow, not lime. Using their vocabulary.
yellow.usage: RESERVED. Exactly one element per screen may be yellow: the primary voice action. brand.ink on brand.yellow measures 15.64:1.
yellow.rule: Yellow never carries text meaning and is never used for status. If yellow appears twice on a screen, the screen is wrong.

unusedSwatches.note: Present in their brand, deliberately not used here.
unusedSwatches.reason: Three near-black greens are a marketing luxury. On a plant floor one inverse surface is enough, and more would dilute the meaning of the listening state.

inverse.usage: Full-bleed states only: listening, safety stop.

text.$rule: No text token below 7:1 exists. AA (4.5:1) is insufficient under washdown glare and in dim cold-store lighting.

stop.rule: Only for hazard, lockout/tagout, and refusal-to-answer states. Never for validation errors, never decorative. A worker must be able to trust that red means stop working.

caution.usage: Requires a qualified person, PPE required, verify before acting.

pending.usage: Escalated and waiting on a human.

highContrast.description: Not a preference, but a lighting condition. Toggled by the worker, persists per device.
highContrast.$rule: In high-contrast mode every border becomes 2px solid and all decorative fills are removed. Lime is retained; it is the only colour that survives.

min.reason: 44px assumes a bare fingertip. A cut-resistant glove has a contact patch of roughly 14-16mm and no proprioceptive feedback. 64px is the floor here, and nothing interactive may be smaller.

primary.reason: The push-to-talk target must be hittable without looking, by someone holding a part in their other hand.

spacing.reason: Minimum gap between adjacent targets. Gloved mis-taps are the dominant input error, and an accidental tap on a safety-critical control is not recoverable by undo.

min.reason: Read at arm's length from a wall-mounted screen, often through safety glasses, frequently by workers over 50. 14px exists in this system only for timestamps and audit metadata, never for instructions.

family.$note: System stack first on low-end devices. Web font is progressive enhancement only. The layout must not shift when it fails to load on a throttled connection.

typography.$rule: Maximum 65 characters per line. Multilingual: German compounds and Romanian diacritics both overflow. Every text container must wrap, never truncate. Truncation of a safety instruction is a defect.

focus.reason: Thick because the device may be operated with a stylus or knuckle, and because focus is the only affordance available to a screen-reader user in a noisy environment.

motion.$rule: Nothing animates longer than 200ms and nothing animates position. A worker glancing away for two seconds must find the screen where they left it. All motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

elevation.$rule: No shadows. Under direct washdown lighting a soft shadow is invisible, so hierarchy is carried by border and surface colour alone. This keeps the system legible when printed to a laminated card for the line, which customers do.
